summary: The SwiftUI shell: the sky and theme, components, navigation, sign-in, the agreement, legal pages, accounts and settings.

src/App.jsx.note: The app's states (the legal pages, restoring, a sign-in that came back without a session, the agreement screen and its checking line, the front page, the shell, remade per account), useProfile, and the archive's provider (ArchiveHost, one ArchiveModel per signed-in account, its store in the app's file store; deleting an account's data deletes its archive and starts every store handle afresh). Not yet: the composer's provider and a compose link kept from before a sign-in (pendingCompose.js, VirgaPosting's), the dashboards' provider (the shell reads the stored dashboards itself, ShellDashboards.swift), keepScansFor (Defense), and drawing the shell again when the formats change. On iOS a sign-in comes back into the running app, so a failed one is the session's error on whatever page is up.

src/accounts/AccountMenu.jsx.note: All of it, with the compact menu's Sync now once there is an archive to sync. A native Menu: an account's row carries a person glyph, since a native menu item can't show the picture. The pending-work read before a long session's sign-out goes through AppModel.pendingWork, nil until VirgaPosting's schedule and timer services are wired to Virga's server; until then the sign-out says it couldn't check, as the web does when the read fails.

src/accounts/AccountsSettings.jsx.note: All of it; the pending-work warnings read through AppModel.pendingWork, nil until VirgaPosting's schedule and timer services are wired, so a long session reads as one that couldn't be checked. Refocusing the next row's ⋯ after a removal is the system's.

src/accounts/SessionNotices.jsx.note: The hand-off before a sign-in again (with Cancel), the stuck account's button and the sign-in's notices. Deliberately not: 'another tab switched accounts', since every window of the app shares one session (AppModel).

src/accounts/accounts.css.note: The rows of Settings › Account, the front page's remembered accounts and the session notices. The account menu's list styles are the native Menu's on iOS.

src/charts/charts.css.note: The chart tokens (--chart-1/2, --chart-area, --chart-grid, --chart-ghost, --heat-0 to 6, --second-tip), the series chart's strokes, dashes, dots and marks, the tooltip's own grounds, the table view, the bar list, the heatmap and the sparkline. Not as the web: the plot's margins and the rules' numbers are Swift Charts' own layout, and the widget's hidden marks list (.widget .an-chart-marks) waits for the dashboards.

src/components/Delta.jsx.note: DeltaView(pct:title:plain:) draws ChartFormat.deltaText(pct) (charts/format.js, VirgaArchive): nil is "new"; a caller with no comparison at all (the web's undefined) draws none. The title is read by VoiceOver as a hint.

src/dashboards/dashboards.css.note: The grid's twelve columns and gaps with the container rules (860 and 620), the card's spans, the figure (.stat), the arrange list and the library. Not yet: the customizing grid's dashed outlines, handles and floating tools, the drop marks, and the library beside the grid.

src/defense/defense.css.note: Measure.Defense names its measures (the 44rem column, the bands' 10rem, the marks, the confirm's 34rem, the new list's 12rem, the keep form's 14rem, the link code, and the radar's: its 600, its 1000-unit square, the rings' and marks' widths, the labels' places, the callout and the legend); the views draw its rules (prose, the field, your posts, the progress, the failure, the result, the radar's colours in the page's tokens, the ticks, the lists, the plans). Its forced-colours rules never apply on iOS, and the hover rules have no pointer.

src/legal/TermsGate.jsx.note: All of it but the Reload link after TERMS_VERSION_MISMATCH: the app's documents are bundled, so loading them again can't bring newer ones; the words still say so.

src/pages/Landing.jsx.note: All of it but the live sky and the five taps on the mark (src/hillside), and the compose link's callout (composing), which waits for pendingCompose.js.

src/posting/composer/composer.css.note: The composer's sheet, posts, editor (its type and highlights), media, embed cards, settings row, busy line and foot, the language picker, tags, post as and the send button, from the measures in ComposerMeasure.swift. Not yet: the drop target, the skeletons' shimmer, the slash list, the when panel, and the adviser's places.

src/posting/library/library.css.note: The template editor (.tpl-form, the text's foot, a new blank's rule, the questions between hairlines and their two columns from 640, the attach rows and the posts to quote with the accent's rule, the grid, the shortcut's slash, the foot), the questions and the preview (.lib-questions, .lib-answers, .lib-preview, the parts, the attachment's card, the bones). Measure.Templates names them. Not yet: the library panel's (its shelves, list, detail and dialog) and the hover rules. A blank still to answer is in brackets in the run of words, where the web draws a dashed chip.

src/posting/pages/hub.css.note: The Templates page (.hub-row, .tpl-row-item with Use and the ⋯ on the name's line, .tpl-name, .tpl-shortcut-chip, .tpl-chip as a tint, .tpl-group-head), the notice, the empty block, the bones (.hub-skeleton, .hub-bone) and the error. Not yet: the overview's columns and nav, the timed rows, the quotes and the spinner, which come with their pages.

src/posting/posting.css.note: `.composer-dialog`'s width (ComposerMeasure), the long-session notice (.needs-backend) and a post shown small (.post-preview, its compact form, head, words, foot and counts), in Measure.Posting; the gates editor follows GatesEditor.jsx's own layout. The rest comes with the posting pages.

src/posting/ui/adviser.css.note: Measure.Adviser names every measure: the busy line (the accent's rule, the goals' pills, the actions, equal shares on a phone), the sheet (the verdict in its tone, the draft under a rule in ink, the marks underlined in their tone, the fixes on --surface-3, the tally, the notes and their markers on the washes, Fine against, the context and usage lines, the notices, the skeleton), the style dialog (the stages and their dots), and the settings' stacks, checks, indent, style row and What’s sent. The dialogs are the system's sheets, full height on a phone. Not yet: the alt-text dialog's describing and revising (.alt-kind, .alt-revise, .alt-chips, .alt-field-tools).

src/reports/reports.css.note: The index's tiles (at least 220 wide, each under a 2-point rule) and a report's cards in one column. Not yet: the report's split columns, the post rows, the content report and the notes.

src/settings/SettingsPage.jsx.note: The index (a phone's), Account, Data and sync (the archive's line, the sync's steps and Cancel, what failed, Sync now or the rest of a build, Rebuild posts and its dialog, the JSON and CSV exports through the system's exporter, where it is kept with the app folder's size for the web's storage estimate, and Delete this archive with its dialog, the toast and the way home), Dashboards (Your dashboards with New dashboard at its head, each dashboard's name as the way to it with its count of reports, its ⋯ with Rename…, Move up, Move down and Delete while there is more than one, its dialogs, Reset to the three starting dashboards with its dialog and toast, and Where they’re kept; the focus after a move or a delete is the system's to place), Appearance (the sky, the accent with its swatches, contrast, density, the sidebar, numbers and dates), Permissions and About (with the Terms and the Privacy Policy, the agreement's date, and when the repo was last read). Posting is PostingSettingsSection (ui-posting.json says what of it is there). Not yet: Appearance's live sky (the hillside). Data's "Keep it when space runs low" is shown only where the browser can be asked (navigator.storage.persist), which iOS has no counterpart for, so it isn't drawn.

src/settings/settings.css.note: The index, the section, the row, the permissions and sources lists, the sky's tiles, the accent's choices, the sync's lines and the dashboards' list (each name ending in an ellipsis with its count on its baseline, the ⋯ let out to the column's edge on a phone). The default timer's rule editor (.settings-rule-editor) comes with LifespanEditor.

src/share/share.css.note: Measure.Share (the dialog's 640, the 16 between its parts, the description's 110 and 1.45); the picture's box with its --line edge, --radius-lg and --bg in ShareDialog. A phone's dialog is a sheet like any other.

src/shell/CommandPalette.jsx.note: The palette as a full-height sheet, over VirgaInsights' Commands (buildCommands with CommandContext.app, paletteGroups, rememberRecent and parseRecent under virga:palette-recent, moveActive): the field on its line with Close, the groups, each option's icon (the account's picture for another account), title, hint (under the title on a phone, once there is a search) and tick, the empty line, the foot beside the sidebar, the result count read out, and the arrows, Home, End, Return and Escape on a hardware keyboard. Search in the app bar, the sidebar and the rail opens it, and ⌘K. Running: an address through the navigator, Sync, the period (with the web's toast), the sky, another account, Customize this dashboard (?edit=1 and the dashboard's page made again, so it opens customizing: the shell's ShellActions) and New dashboard (the shell's dialog, once the palette's sheet has gone). Not yet: the composer itself (New post goes to the composer's address).

src/shell/FirstRun.jsx.note: The first build's page, word for word: what a build reads and where it goes, the store's warning when the archive would only last the session, Build your archive (a full sync), the steps while it runs (SyncSteps), and what failed. Shown by RoutedPage where a route needs the archive and it isn't built.

src/shell/MobileNav.jsx.note: The tab bar and the app bar: on a part's front page the mark, Search and the account in the page's content, scrolling away with the sky; inside a part the system's back button with the page above's name, Search and the account, in the navigation bar; Search opens the command palette, and the account's menu holds Sync now once there is an archive. Not yet: the mark's five taps (the live sky) and the composer (New post goes to its address).

src/shell/Shell.jsx.note: The shell by the window's width (from 900 Virga's own sidebar beside the page, held to --shell-max and centred, with one sky behind both that the page's scroll moves; under it a stack with the app bar and tab bar), the address as its state, every route to a page (a page not ported yet shows its header and says so), NotFound, the dashboard redirect and the last dashboard looked at, the titles, the archive's opening line and the first build's page where a route needs it, and the sync's places (the sidebar's card, or the strip at the top of the page, neither while the first build's page is up). The command palette (from Search, and ⌘K on a hardware keyboard), the toasts and NewDashboardDialog (from the sidebar and the palette; one made empty opens with ?edit=1) are mounted here, and the palette's onCustomize (ShellActions: ?edit=1, and the `customizing` key the dashboard's page is made again by). Not yet: the composer and its shortcut (New post goes to the composer's address), and the live sky.

src/shell/Sidebar.jsx.note: The parts as words with the open one's pages (the dashboards' ending with New dashboard, which opens the shell's dialog), the account, New post, folding to the rail, the list scrolling on a short screen with the edge that has more behind it faded (useOverflowEdge), and the archive's lines at the foot (SyncCard, brief beside the first build's page; on the rail Sync now is in the account's menu). Search or jump to… with its shortcut (a search glyph on the rail) opens the command palette. Not yet: the mark's five taps (the live sky).

src/shell/SyncStatus.jsx.note: overallFraction, syncHeadline, syncStepText, syncWhen, useArchiveCounts and runFor (SyncStatus), SyncCard at the sidebar's foot, SyncBanner at the top of a phone's page and beside the folded rail (drawn by VirgaPage), and SyncSteps on the first build's page. The steps' names and lines are VirgaArchive's SyncProgress. The role=status lines are read as updating frequently.

src/shell/bits.jsx.note: The mark, the page header, toasts (ToastCenter and ToastStack, at most three, each gone after 4.2 seconds, read out by VoiceOver as the web's polite live region is; pushed by the share dialog, Customize and the dashboard's menu, Settings › Dashboards and Data, the palette's period and the tools), useIsNarrow (the theme's hasSidebar), usePeriod (PreferencesModel.period(), setPeriod, setCustomPeriod over VirgaArchive's Periods), PeriodPicker (the presets and Custom; on a phone Custom is its calendar alone) and RangeDialog (two days on the system's date picker in the active time zone, checked as they are picked, with the web's three problems and its line on what the range covers). Not yet: useSkyTaps (the live sky).

src/shell/commandPalette.css.note: The field (no box, a 2-point rule in ink, 52 tall, --text-lg and 16 from 374 down), Close on its line, the list's groups and options (40 tall, 48 on a phone, the highlighted one on --hover), the tick, the empty line, the foot and the keys (.kbd), a phone's hints under the titles and waiting for a search. The sheet is the system's at every width: the web's dialog near the top of a wide screen (620 wide, 12vh down) has no counterpart.

src/shell/shell.css.note: The shell, its figure size, the sidebar and rail (the list's overflow fades, 24 at the edge with more behind it; a short screen's closer parts and the card without its counts), the page header and body, the app bar and tab bar, dialogs, choices and toasts, the sync's places, the first run, the period picker and the range dialog's fields. The sidebar's search row and the app bar's Search button too.

src/signin/HandleField.jsx.note: All of it, a combobox on a hardware keyboard as on the web: ↑ and ↓ open the suggestions on the first or the last, then move through them round through the field itself (SignInSuggest.moveActive); the marked one on --hover with 2 points of ink at its edge, the pointer's only shaded; Return takes the marked one (or, with none marked, submits as the field always does); Escape puts the list away (the dialog it may be in stays) and Tab leaves it closed. The marked one is read as the field's value. A press picks one.

src/styles/app.css.note: a few of its measures (the landing page's bar, title, lede and points, the return screen's title, the restoring message and its animation) are in ThemeKit (VirgaCore/Theme, from ios/parity/cases/_themeKit.js); it sets no theme tokens. The pages are VirgaUI's: the front page, its hero, points, foot and sketch (Pages/LandingView.swift), the narrow column and the restoring line (Pages/SignInReturnView.swift), with the measures ThemeKit doesn't read named in Theme/Measures.swift until _themeKit.js reads them; the live sky's frame waits for the hillside

src/styles/base.css.note: the page's type (body size, line height, numerals, headings, links, code), focus outline, selection and the sky's wash are measures in ThemeKit (VirgaCore/Theme); it sets no theme tokens. VirgaUI draws them: the type in Instrument Sans with tabular figures (Theme/Typography.swift), the sky from the window's top behind the page, moved by its scroll, and once behind the sidebar and the page together beside the sidebar (Theme/SkyWash.swift), the focus outline (Components/Focus.swift), Reduce Motion (Theme/Motion.swift). The element resets, ::selection and the helper classes (.visually-hidden, .skip-link) have no counterpart on iOS

src/styles/controls.css.note: 246 of its declarations, the kit's measures, are in ThemeKit (VirgaCore/Theme, listed in ios/parity/cases/_themeKit.js). The components are VirgaUI's (Components/): the button's tiers and sizes, the link action and the more link, Segmented and the sideways row, the section and its head, foot and caption, the row and its actions, figures and the delta, the menu (native), fields and the text area, the check and the switch, badges, the meta line, chips, tokens, avatars, the dot, the table, the empty state, the note, the callout, the disclosure, progress, the info tip, and the touch block's sizes. Not yet: the list toolbar (.list-toolbar), the chart foot (.chart-foot) and select.input's own chevron (a native Picker), which come with the pages that use them; a few touch reaches ThemeKit doesn't read are in Theme/Measures.swift

src/styles/theme.css.note: every token it sets on <html> and the cascade that picks them, in VirgaCore/Theme, resolved at a window's root and read as @Environment(\.virgaTheme) (Theme/VirgaTheme.swift). Its high-contrast rules for components are drawn in VirgaUI: the focus outline (Components/Focus.swift), a pressed key's line (Components/Segmented.swift), the switch, its knob at 70% (Components/Switch.swift), the narrow tab bar's disc's ring (Shell/MobileNav.swift); not yet heat cells and bar tracks (the charts), the current page's underline and the image labels. Its forced-colours rules are recorded but never apply: no device the app runs on has them.

src/tools/tools.css.note: Measure.Tools names every measure the tool pages use (the list of tools, the statement, the filter figures, the line over a table, the inline select, the activity check, the large search, the unfollow log's groups, the queue's ✕, the best slots, identity, the facts and the timeline, the lookup's field, its suggestions floating over the page, pair counts, legend, totals and events), and dashboards.css's person and post rows as the tools list them; each view draws its rules from them. The cleanup and lists tables are tables from 641 wide (the tick box's 36, the account's column taking what the rest leave, its words ending in an ellipsis, a ticked row's tint 10 past the sides, a row's own Unfollow stepping back while rows are ticked) and set as the web's phone sets them narrower. The hover rules are the pointer's on an iPad: a suggestion under the pointer becomes the active one; a name's underline on hover is left to the system's pointer effect.
